messages:
Nora: Aperture Systems escalated to execs. Pilot paused unless we clear three items: SSO metadata + allowlist, pilot commercial cap, SOC2/KMS deliverables. Need quick triage.
Caleb: Tech: they need SAML metadata + websocket egress CIDRs. Preliminary CIDRs: 3.121.0.0/16, 18.198.0.0/15. Will confirm with infra. We do not support mTLS for Hosted.
Jules: Security & privacy: BYO-KMS only for Private deployments. For Hosted we can offer cloud KMS integrations but keys are provider-managed. They also asked for SOC2 type II summary and pen test highlights.
LegalBot: To share SOC2 artifacts we require a signed NDA + DPA. I can push a DPA template; GC review needed for redlines.
Nora: Commercial ask: they want 40% off pilot + conversion credits. Finance won't approve >30% without CRO signoff. @Jules can you prepare a one-page security brief we can give post-NDA?
Jules: Yes. I'll assemble SOC2 summary, redacted controls matrix, and BYO-KMS explanation (ETA EOD).
Caleb: Action: confirm CIDRs and SAML metadata template (ETA 1h).
Nora: I'll ping CRO and schedule an exec bridge for tomorrow 11am PT. If DPA + CIDRs arrive before the bridge we can close most asks.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Aperture exec bridge" tomorrow 11:00 PT. Organizer: Nora.
Nora: Thanks team. Post quick updates here if anything blocks the bridge.
